digest.component_or_area: CLI commands (edit, claim) and plan-review gate integration
propositions: edit --review must parse as a valueless flag and invoke review_plan after the EDIT event commits, exiting with disposition codes 0/1/2/11 per ADR 0040 (PASS/BLOCK/INDETERMINATE/retryable respectively)
claim --review must sense gate applicability via shared _plan_review_gate_applies, call claim_gate_check to determine if review is needed, and proceed to claim only on a PASS verdict
claim --review must not invoke the claim core and must exit with the review verdict's disposition code (1/2/11) when the gate applies but review returns BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, or retryable degradation
both flags must release the store lock before invoking review_plan so that multi-minute LLM passes run without lock contention
both flags must propagate exceptions from review_plan through the standard CLI error handler, leaving the edit committed and preventing the claim from being attempted
